definition: Inkling is an open-weights large language model created by Thinking Machines company, first released on July 15, 2026.
details: It is published under an Apache 2.0 license. The model allows text, images and audio as input, and can be used for tasks such as chat, software development, multilingual applications or agentic systems.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. That pattern-earned fluency is Inkling (large language model).
